thread:
incident-bot: [PAGER] Cluster phi: tokenizer-preproc pods showing sustained high CPU (avg 950m) and multiple restarts in last 7m. Node flapping reported. Autoresolve=false

maya (oncall): I'm paged in. Taking lead. Triage window 15m. @raj pls grab logs, @sophia tag runtime impact.

raj: On it. Spawning a flamegraph and tailing /var/log/tokenizer.log now. Suspect pathological regex on very long prompts.

sophia (eng-runtime): Seeing ~15% 5xx on /v1/generate in region-phi. Latency climbs for a couple seconds before pods restart. Crashloop and OOMs on tokenizer-preproc pods.

derek (eng-sre): Node phi-worker-07 showing Kubelet evictions; system processes getting OOM-killed. Likely CPU saturating kubelet and causing node readiness flaps.

maya (oncall): Quick mitigations I want now: 1) scale tokenizer-preproc down to reduce global scheduling churn 2) enforce soft CPU limits on the deployment 3) cordon and drain the worst node (phi-worker-07) 4) shift some traffic to region-beta. Deploy config toggle to reject enormous raw payloads.

ops-bot: Runbook linked: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/tokenizer-hotloops

raj: Sample from tokenizer log tail:

```
2026-03-15T10:02:14Z INFO parsing prompt raw_len=11234 user=svc-acme
2026-03-15T10:02:15Z WARN prefix_cache miss - doing full tokenize
2026-03-15T10:02:16Z ERROR allocation failed: out-of-memory during tokenize loop
stack: tokenize::inner -> regex::find_iter -> backtrack -> vec::push -> oom
```

raj: That pattern (very long raw prompt) is driving exponential backtracking in the regex. We have an open branch with a fix, but it's not in production yet.

sophia (eng-runtime): Confirmed: a degenerate input path causes heavy CPU per request, pushing containers to their limits and then OOMing. We need short-term traffic controls.

maya (oncall): Executing changes now:

```
kubectl -n inference scale deploy/tokenizer-preproc --replicas=6
kubectl -n inference set resources deploy/tokenizer-preproc --requests=cpu=250m --limits=cpu=1
kubectl cordon phi-worker-07
kubectl drain phi-worker-07 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force
```

infra-eng: Canary image ready: tokenizer:v2026.03.10-guard. Deploying 1 replica to region-beta and routing 5% traffic there.

customer-success: Notifying customers who reported errors. Messaging: "We're investigating elevated errors from tokenization; mitigation in progress."

ops-bot: Configmap change proposed: inference/tokenizer-config (toggle tokenizer.max_raw_chars=50000).

maya (oncall): Applying config toggle to remaining replicas to hard-fail huge payloads with 413 while we roll the patch.

ops-bot: Configmap updated: inference/tokenizer-config

raj: Rolling a lightweight code-path guard as a config toggle too: if raw_chars > 50k -> return 413 with guidance. Will open an ops toggle so we can revert quickly.

sophia (eng-runtime): Canary in beta healthy after 3m under 5% traffic. No CPU spike. Rolling to 30% then to phi gradually.

infra-eng: Starting staged rollout to phi (10% -> 30% -> 100%). Image: tokenizer:v2026.03.10-guard.

raj: Observed a handful of legacy payloads still hitting old pods in the queue; draining and restarting those pods clears the backlog.

maya (oncall): Declaring incident Sev2. Impact: multiple customers saw tokenization errors; majority of traffic served normally. Creating incident ticket.

ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0315-phi-tokenizer (https://redwood.incidents/INC-2026-0315-phi-tokenizer)

sophia (eng-runtime): Rolling to 100% in phi now. New pods show baseline CPU. No new OOMs for 12m on new image.

derek (eng-sre): phi-worker-07 cordoned/drained. We'll schedule kubelet threshold tuning and OS-level OOM adjustments during maintenance before uncordoning. Node flaps stopped post-drain.

maya (oncall): Handoff notes for next oncall (Alice) at 14:00 UTC:
- Probable root cause: regex backtracking on extremely long prompt inputs causing CPU hotloop -> process OOM -> pod container restarts -> node kubelet flaps.
- Actions taken: scaled down tokenizer-preproc, added CPU requests/limits, cordoned and drained unstable node, pushed config toggle to reject >50k raw chars, canary+rollout of guarded tokenizer image, customer outreach.
- Open items: add ingress-based max raw char validator, add e2e long-prompt test, add rate-limit guidance to docs, follow-up PR to remove regex degenerate path.

alice (oncall-next): Ack. I'll monitor the rollout metrics and the incident ticket during the handoff window. Page me if error rate > 2% or CPU/memory exceed thresholds.

raj: Opening PR for tokenizer backoff guard and benchmark: https://github.com/redwood/tokenizer/pull/428 (includes long prompt tests).

sophia (eng-runtime): Recommend adding a gateway-enforced limit for tokenization raw size and returning a consistent 413 with docs link. Adding to runtime backlog.

customer-success: Sent an update to impacted customers noting mitigation and ETA for permanent fix (~24h).

ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-0315-phi-tokenizer status: stabilized -> monitoring

maya (oncall): Adding post-incident action items to the ticket and assigning owners. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-0315-phi-tokenizer closed by maya (status set to monitoring) at 2026-03-15T14:05:00Z
notes: Postmortem tasks: add long-prompt CI, gateway validator, tune kubelet oom_score_adj, update docs and rate limit guidance
